description: Foundation step 3 (docs/UNIFIED-PROJECT-PLAN.md §5/§7): stand up the Python FastAPI service shell that will replace the Node/Express backend, capture the current API as a parity baseline, set up an auto-registering router pattern so later port tasklists don't collide, and wire a REAL .chief/verify.sh. After this, the Python service can serve the client and every subsequent tasklist ports one route group behind the parity gate.

userStories.title: Capture the Express API contract as the parity baseline
userStories.description: Generate a machine-readable spec of every current route (method, path, request/response shape) from the running TS Express server, plus recorded sample responses the React client depends on. This is the contract the ported Python routes must satisfy.
acceptanceCriteria: A committed parity spec (e.g. contracts/parity/openapi.json + a fixtures set of representative request/response pairs) covers every /api/* route the client calls.
A parity test harness can replay a recorded request against a handler and assert the response matches the baseline shape.
The spec is generated by a script (repeatable), not hand-written.

userStories.title: FastAPI service shell with auto-registering routers
userStories.description: Create the pinakes (services/api) FastAPI app: it serves the built web/ client, exposes a health route, and auto-discovers router modules from a routers package so each later port tasklist adds its own file without editing shared app wiring (enabling parallel ports). Unported routes return 501.
acceptanceCriteria: services/api/src/pinakes/ contains a FastAPI app that starts via uvicorn and serves web/'s build output at the root.
Routers are auto-registered by scanning a routers/ package (drop-in a module -> it's mounted; no central edit).
A documented catalog of not-yet-ported routes returns HTTP 501 with a clear body, driven by the parity spec so coverage is trackable.
services/api has a pyproject.toml in the root uv workspace and its own tests/ dir with the shell smoke test.

userStories.title: Wire a real .chief/verify.sh merge gate
userStories.description: Replace the 'EDIT ME' stub with a real gate that runs the relevant checks based on what a branch changed: Python pytest (engine + services/api), the parity/contract tests, and the web typecheck.
acceptanceCriteria: .chief/verify.sh runs engine pytest, services/api pytest, the parity tests, and `bun run check` as appropriate to the diff, and exits non-zero on any failure.
It uses $CHIEF_BASE_BRANCH to scope checks to what changed and is idempotent from a clean worktree.
Running it on this branch passes; deliberately breaking a test makes it fail (demonstrated).
